criteria.text: Identifies that the Saltash Logistics plc contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Identifies that the 5-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 12-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.5 is stated as $2,400,000 but 10% of the $20,000,000 Purchase Price is $2,000,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Lists the Saltash Logistics plc change-of-control consent as a required third-party consent and states it has not been obtained.
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (10% x $20,000,000 = $2,000,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $2,400,000.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
